note: The day-one wording. Its criteria restate the rule that defines arm C on purpose: arm A then measures how faithfully Jev follows a rule it is given (test-retest, agreement with rule_c, calibration). Arm B is what the night shift makes of this same text. Only the `action` question is ever rewritten; skip/up15/down15 are carried unchanged into every later version. Wording is original; the shape (one choice with three criteria, one veto noul) follows the public article this project measures.

action.instructions: Decide whether to be long SOL for the next fifteen minutes. Buy on strength only when the book can absorb the order; get flat when the move fades or the market turns violent.

criteria.buy: the trend is pumping, volatility is not violent, and liquidity is not thin
criteria.sell: the trend is dumping, or volatility is violent
criteria.hold: anything else: keep whatever position is already on

skip.instructions: Conditions are too hostile to trade at all this cycle.

criteria.yes: liquidity is thin and volatility is violent, or the flow is a bot war on a thin book
criteria.no: the market is orderly enough that a small order would fill near the quote

up15.instructions: The mid price will be higher fifteen minutes from now.

criteria.yes: the trend and flow point to the price rising over the next quarter hour
criteria.no: the price is more likely to be flat or lower

down15.instructions: The mid price will be lower fifteen minutes from now.

criteria.yes: the trend and flow point to the price falling over the next quarter hour
criteria.no: the price is more likely to be flat or higher
